test_condition: UST 10Y stays at or above 4.70% while SMH cumulative return vs SPY worsens by >= 1pp from the 2026-09-02 level (both confirm); 10Y falling below 4.70% while SMH recovers vs SPY would refute
resolution_note: Neither literal condition triggered. 10Y stayed at/above 4.70% every session (in fact rose further, to 4.83% by 09-09, a fresh cycle high) -- the confirm test's rate half held -- but SMH did not worsen vs SPY; it swung to +4.69pp cumulative outperformance since the 09-02 baseline (SMH +4.33%, SPY -0.36%), the opposite of 'worsens.' The refute test's rate half (10Y below 4.70%) never fired either, so refute doesn't cleanly apply as written. Reported plainly rather than forced into either box: rates kept climbing while software/semis decisively recovered, which argues against a pure rates-driven read for the sector but the test as designed didn't anticipate this combination. Expired unresolved at its own deadline.
